answer: Overthinking hurts because the mind keeps trying to solve an emotional problem with endless analysis. Reflection creates clarity, but rumination creates the illusion of control while keeping you trapped in the same fear. The hidden cost is that you experience the pain of many possible futures without actually living any of them. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my Quora profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. The mind becomes exhausting when it mistakes thinking about life for actually moving through it.
